'''RamapoCon 3''' was a Decipher-oriented convention held 7–10 June 2001 at Ramapo College in Mahwah, New Jersey.<ref name="ramapo3">[https://web.archive.org/web/20071217070344/http://www.swccgpc.com/ramapocon/index.html RamapoCon 3], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 17 December 2007)</ref> [[Scott Lingrell]] organized it. He had held a Decipher-oriented convention at Ramapo College, just outside of New York City, for two years.<ref name="ramapo3" />

* '''Dates:''' 7–10 June 2001.<ref name="ramapo3" />
* '''Site:''' Ramapo College, 505 Ramapo Valley Road, Mahwah, New Jersey 07430-1680.<ref name="ramapo3" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Scott Lingrell]].<ref name="ramapo3" />

Registration hours were Thursday 7 June, 5 pm to 12 am; Friday 8 June, 10 am to 8 pm.<ref name="ramapo3" /> Saturday 9 June ran from 8 am to 6 pm, and Sunday 10 June from 10 am to 2 pm.<ref name="ramapo3" />

The convention included World Championship open qualifiers for Decipher's [[Star Wars CCG|Star Wars]], [[Star Trek CCG|Star Trek]], [[Young Jedi]], and [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game|Jedi Knights]].<ref name="ramapo3" /> The winner of each qualifier earned a bye into Day 2 of the [[2001 Decipher World Championship|2001 World Championships]].<ref name="ramapo3" />

The site announced the Final Nights Pre-Release Tournament for Vampire: The Eternal Struggle on Saturday 9 June, from 1 pm to 9 pm.<ref name="ramapo3" /> Entry was limited to the first 40 players.<ref name="ramapo3" /> Each player was to buy one starter and three booster packs.<ref name="ramapo3" />
